captures.label: batch ids across the thin views
captures.sql:
SELECT 'batch ids across the thin views' AS check_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT batch_id) AS distinct_batches, MAX(batch_id) AS batch_seen
FROM ( SELECT batch_id FROM D_VIEWS.V_CUSTOMER_360
       UNION ALL SELECT batch_id FROM D_VIEWS.V_POLICY_SUMMARY )
rows: batch ids across the thin views
captures.expect_text:
/* EXPECT  distinct_batches = 0 and batch_seen = NULL — D_LIVE is still empty.
   FIXED 27 Oct — this said distinct_batches = 1, which cannot happen:
   COUNT(DISTINCT batch_id) over an empty set is 0, not 1. The expectation was
   arithmetically impossible, so the check could only ever fail. The point it
   makes is the right one — nothing was published — and 0 is what proves it. */
captures.detail: distinct_batches=0; batch_seen=NULL
